title: Man on US Capitol Steps, 1949 Washington DC Snapshot B&W
description: A black and white photograph of a man standing confidently on the wide stone steps of the United States Capitol Building in Washington, D.C., taken in June 1949. The man is dressed in classic late-1940s style with high-waisted trousers and a casual collared shirt. Towering classical columns and sculptured architectural details frame the upper background, highlighting post-WWII American travel and civic tourism.
